definitions.explanation: The distance or route of a trip, or the journey itself. Used when discussing travel distance or the schedule of a trip.
A step or stage in a manufacturing or mechanical process, including the stroke of a piston or similar mechanism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{片道|かたみち}→片道：00199_katamichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行程|こうてい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧3⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧だ。
examples.english: The one-way journey is about three hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行程|こうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。

⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行程|こうてい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: The journey to the summit is steep, but the scenery is wonderful.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4{行程|こうてい}サイクル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: This machine operates on a four-stroke cycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧{行程|こうてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各段階|かくだんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Quality inspections are conducted at each stage of the manufacturing process.

notes: Composed of {行|こう} (go, travel) + {程|てい} (degree, extent, distance). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{工程|こうてい}→工程：12415_koutei⟧ (work process, production schedule), which focuses specifically on work/production steps, while {行程|こうてい} in sense 2 refers to mechanical strokes or stages. Common collocations: {行程|こうてい}{表|ひょう} (itinerary chart), ⟦{往復|おうふく}→往復：04111_oufuku⟧{行程|こうてい} (round-trip distance), ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行程|こうてい} (a day's journey). In mountaineering and hiking, {行程|こうてい} specifically refers to the route distance and time estimate for the climb.
